scope: Close the official-build half of the {root} include approval. sources.json was already edited (two tokens only) and the approval is closed. This pass ran python3 tools/build/sources.py build --device g2 --out build/ws-em9305-20261122/full-rootI-232930, final-linked the official composed g2-em9305.o with tree g2/src/em9305/link/g2-em9305.ld, packaged with split_bootloader_image + build_package, and spliced a private NOR.
